l1_words.meaning: to carry out, to put into action

pattern_explanation: These Ukrainian words look like English words but came into Ukrainian with different meanings, so the English look-alikes mislead learners. Students often assume the similar English word has the same meaning.
false_friend_warning: Careful: actual, concrete, eventually and realize look like Ukrainian words but do not mean the same thing in English. The Ukrainian words mean current, specific, possibly and to carry out.
